menu_ilet_hub_title: GAGARAGOGO ⬝ Group & Broadcast Management ──────────────────────── Select a module to manage: • Instant Broadcast: Send messages or media instantly to selected groups with one tap. • Auto Message: Automatic recurring message engine at set intervals. • Contacts & Group: Sort groups by member count, scrape and add members.
menu_ilet_anlik_title: 📢 INSTANT BULK BROADCAST ──────────────────────── Forwards messages or media to selected groups at once: • .ilet — Forwards the replied message to all selected groups. • .ilet [text] — Sends the written text directly to all groups. • .iletmenu — Panel to toggle which groups to send to.
menu_contacts_desc_full: Please select an action: • Group to Group: Scrapes members from one group and adds to another. • Group to Contacts: Saves group members to your Telegram contacts. • Contacts to Group: Invites your contacts to a selected group. ⚠️ Warning: In mass and autonomous operations, the user bears responsibility if your account is rate-limited or spammed by Telegram.
menu_bc_list_hint: 💡 Click a group's number to toggle its status.
